module: Bounds and clamp functions for the rally co-driver audio spacing settings, in milliseconds: gap between corners, between phrases, between link words and between notes. Each function rounds the value to an integer and clamps it to the allowed range. Used by the editor/settings and by gameplay_rally_audioManager.
notes: cornerGapMs, phraseGapMs and linkWordGapMs are the SAME table (min -200, max 200): changing one changes the other two.
A negative value means the audio clips overlap (inferred from the field name and its usage in audioManager).

cornerGapMs.desc: Bounds {min=-200, max=200} of the gap between corners (ms). Table shared with phraseGapMs and linkWordGapMs.

phraseGapMs.desc: Bounds {min=-200, max=200} of the gap between phrases (ms).

linkWordGapMs.desc: Bounds {min=-200, max=200} of the gap with link words (ms).

pacenoteGapMs.desc: Bounds {min=-100, max=400} of the gap between two notes (ms).

clampCornerGapMs.desc: Rounds and clamps a corner gap to cornerGapMs.

value.desc: Value in ms; converted with tonumber, 0 if invalid.

clampPhraseGapMs.desc: Rounds and clamps a phrase gap to phraseGapMs.

clampLinkWordGapMs.desc: Rounds and clamps a link word gap to linkWordGapMs.

clampPacenoteGapMs.desc: Rounds and clamps a note gap to pacenoteGapMs.
